mcbilingual.settings.title: Bilingual Chat
mcbilingual.settings.subtitle: Automatic translation · Kit local service
mcbilingual.settings.enabled.tip: Translate incoming chat. Original messages remain available if translation fails.
mcbilingual.settings.mode.tip: Cycle automatic and on-demand translation. Click a message or [Translate] in on-demand mode.
mcbilingual.settings.target.tip: Cycle the incoming translation language. Source language is detected automatically.
mcbilingual.settings.system.tip: Translate server notices and plugin chat, excluding action bar messages.
mcbilingual.settings.own.tip: Translate your own chat when received from the server. Off by default.
mcbilingual.settings.outgoing.tip: Translate normal chat before sending it to the server. Off by default. Commands are never translated.
mcbilingual.settings.outgoing_target.tip: Target language used when outgoing translation is enabled.
mcbilingual.settings.check.tip: Check that the local translation helper and model are available.
mcbilingual.settings.anti_spam.tip: Detect repeated chat within a time window. Default: 3 repeats in 15 seconds. Thresholds can be changed in the config file.
mcbilingual.settings.ignore.tip: For detected spam, send /ignore only when the server explicitly supports it and the player name is valid.
mcbilingual.settings.outgoing_notice: Outgoing translation is sent to the server
mcbilingual.settings.start.tip: Start the local helper, reusing a running service.
mcbilingual.settings.open_helper.tip: Open the helper to prepare Apple language packs.
